sources.title: Co-DINO Models | Sense-X/Co-DETR | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Co-DINO models are an extension of the DINO (DETR with Improved deNoising anchOr boxes) architecture that incorporates the collaborative hybrid assignments training scheme introduced by Co-DETR. These models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in object detection benchmarks, with the highest-performing variant reaching 66.0 AP on COCO test-dev.
